script_text: Wait, Stop, Listen. This week's cosmic currents for Virgo are about to shift. Mercury trine Jupiter on Monday ignites your communication channels—perfect for sealing deals or sparking creative collaborations. Tuesday's Venus square Neptune may blur your boundaries; trust your intuition but double-check agreements. Wednesday's Sun conjunct Pluto demands deep self-reflection—confront hidden patterns. Thursday's Mars in Virgo fuels productivity—tackle long-overdue tasks. Friday's Mercury opposite Saturn tests your patience—avoid impulsive decisions. Saturday's Moon in Scorpio intensifies emotions—practice self-care. Sunday's Mercury sextile Neptune sparks artistic inspiration—journal or meditate. Best days: Monday (communication) and Thursday (productivity). Worst: Friday (impulsivity). Action: Monday, network strategically. Thursday, organize your space. Friday, pause before acting.
